### Cognitive Profile  
Your current CEFR A2+ level means you can handle everyday situations with basic phrases, like ordering food or asking for directions. This reflects your solid foundation in vocabulary (133 unique words tested) and strong listening exposure (100% score), though more complex conversations will require expanding your word bank and grammatical structures.  

### Strengths & Growth Edges  
- **Precision Learner**: Your 87% spelling accuracy across 1,270 tests shows careful attention to detail—keep leveraging this strength for error-proof recall.  
- **Active Listener**: With 403 audio plays, you’ve immersed yourself in sounds and rhythms—a key habit for pronunciation and comprehension.  

- **Consistency Boost**: Your 47% consistency score suggests irregular practice; try 10-minute daily sessions to reinforce memory stability (currently 83%).  
- **Deeper Engagement**: At 46% engagement, challenge yourself to use mastered words (111 so far) in sentences or voice notes to bridge theory and real-world use.  

### Your Learning Signature  
Your 275 minutes of dwell time prove curiosity outlasts streaks—keep turning small steps into lifelong fluency.
